ad_info.structure_source: uploaded reference (R01.png, a winning ad of this same product)
ad_info.reference_style: Clean beauty-supplement progress-timeline ad: cream canvas, 2x2 grid of day-by-day photo panels, product with carton and a gold offer plaque
ad_info.ad_format: Single Image Ad (2x2 timeline grid with product and offer plaque)

global_identity.color_palette: Warm cream background #FBF3DC; lemon yellow #F2DC4A (product label and carton); metallic gold #C9A441 with lighter gold highlight #E6CF7A (day labels, plaque, panel borders, botanical sprig); near-black #111111 (headline and plaque text); amber brown #8A4B14 (bottle glass); soft white #FFFFFF for highlights inside the photo panels.
global_identity.visual_style: Clean, bright beauty-supplement ad built as a 2x2 progress timeline. Soft, polished, semi-illustrated photographic rendering of the same woman in a bright bedroom, repeated in four rounded panels; tidy, warm and premium.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Light, warm, feminine, optimistic and trustworthy; soft diffused daylight through sheer curtains, no harsh shadows.
global_identity.graphic_language: Rounded-corner rectangular photo panels with a hairline pale-gold border, generous cream margins, one brushed metallic gold plaque with rounded corners and a thin inner border, a thin hairline divider inside the plaque, one delicate pale-gold botanical sprig line drawing behind the product, soft contact shadows under the product.
global_identity.text_typography: Headline in a geometric sans-serif, extra-bold, all uppercase, tight leading, centered, solid near-black (Montserrat ExtraBold / Gotham Black style), no outline and no shadow. Day labels in the same geometric sans, bold, uppercase, metallic gold, small. Plaque text in near-black: first line bold uppercase geometric sans; second line much larger, heavy condensed uppercase sans (Oswald Bold / Bebas style); third line regular-weight uppercase geometric sans with wide letter spacing.

creative_objective: Recreate the attached reference ad exactly (same composition, framing, typography, positions, colors, background and photo style) and change only the headline, which now links appetite with curves for the woman who eats little and does not gain.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: First the big black two-line headline at the top; second the 2x2 grid of day panels read left to right and top to bottom (Day 1, 7, 14, 21); third the gold offer plaque at the bottom right with the product and carton at the bottom left.
art_direction.composition_style: Symmetrical, centered, three horizontal bands on a cream canvas: headline band (top ~15%), 2x2 photo grid (middle ~52%), product plus plaque band (bottom ~33%).
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Even cream margins of about 7% on the left and right; a narrow cream gutter between the four panels; the four panels are identical in size; the product group sits under the left column of panels and the plaque under the right column, vertically centered in the bottom band.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Soft, bright, diffused daylight inside the panels; flat cream canvas with a very subtle lighter center; soft contact shadow under the carton and bottle; gentle brushed-metal sheen on the gold plaque.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Warm cream canvas. Top center: a two-line extra-bold black uppercase headline spanning about 75% of the width. Middle: a 2x2 grid of four equal landscape photo panels with rounded corners and a hairline pale-gold border; each panel has a small bold gold day label in its top-left corner and shows the same woman in the same bright bedroom, in the same pose, seen in a three-quarter back view looking over her shoulder. Bottom left: the tall lemon-yellow carton standing upright with the amber dropper bottle standing in front of it and slightly to its right, and a pale-gold botanical sprig line drawing behind them to the right. Bottom right: a wide brushed-gold plaque with rounded corners and a thin inner border containing three centered lines of black text, with a thin hairline between the second and third lines.

visual_prompt: Recreate the attached reference ad exactly: same composition, framing, typography, text positions, color palette, background and photo style. The only change is the wording of the headline. Square 1:1 beauty-supplement ad on a flat warm cream background (#FBF3DC) with a very subtle lighter center. TOP BAND (top ~15%): a two-line, centered, extra-bold, all-uppercase geometric sans-serif headline in solid near-black (#111111), tight leading, spanning about 80% of the canvas width, no outline and no shadow. MIDDLE BAND (from ~15% to ~66% of the height): a 2x2 grid of four equal landscape photo panels with rounded corners and a hairline pale-gold border, with about 7% cream margin on the left and right and a narrow cream gutter between panels. Every panel shows the same scene with the same framing: a bright, airy cream bedroom with a bed with white linens on the left, sheer white curtains glowing with soft daylight in the background and a green potted palm in a white pot on the right. The same young woman with brown hair in a high ponytail stands right of center in each panel, in a three-quarter back view, looking back over her shoulder at the camera with a soft confident smile, wearing a cream-white racerback sports top and terracotta-brown high-waisted leggings, framed from the head to the upper thighs at eye level. Tasteful, natural fitness-apparel look, not sexualized. From panel to panel her hips and curves look gradually and subtly fuller, in a natural and believable way, while pose, clothes, room and light stay identical. Each panel has a small bold uppercase metallic-gold day label in its top-left corner: top-left panel is day 1, top-right panel is day 7, bottom-left panel is day 14, bottom-right panel is day 21. BOTTOM BAND (bottom ~33%): on the left, under the left column of panels, a tall rectangular lemon-yellow carton standing upright, slightly taller than the bottle, with the lowercase black wordmark 'amua' at the top and 'VITALDROPS' in white uppercase letters running vertically along the front face; standing in front of it and slightly to its right, the product: a 60 ml amber-brown glass dropper bottle with rounded shoulders and a short neck, a black ribbed screw collar and a glossy black rubber bulb dropper, with a wraparound label that fades from bright lemon yellow at the top to white / pale silver at the bottom, showing the lowercase black wordmark 'amua', the large white uppercase name 'VITALDROPS', a small dark line 'All-In-One Multi-Herbal Supplement', five small thin-outlined circular ingredient badges in two rows (A, MA, L and F, BR) and 'Dietary Supplement 2 fl. oz. (60mL)' at the bottom. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the bottle; do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it. A delicate pale-gold botanical sprig line drawing sits just behind and to the right of the bottle. Soft contact shadow under carton and bottle. On the right, under the right column of panels, a wide brushed metallic gold plaque (#C9A441 with lighter #E6CF7A highlights) with rounded corners and a thin inner border, about 50% of the canvas width and 20% of its height, with three centered lines of near-black text: a first line in bold uppercase geometric sans, a second line much larger in heavy condensed uppercase sans, a thin horizontal hairline, and a third line in regular-weight uppercase geometric sans with wide letter spacing. Soft diffused light, clean and premium finish. Do not add any CTA button, extra badge, benefit list, icon, trust seal, rating stars, testimonial, bottom bar, arrow, subtitle, food or any other text or element.
